REVISED
  CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Susan Jakubowski, Mayor  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Steve Talt, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone
Steven W. Huang, DDS, Council Member  (626) 300-0709 Fax
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber
Ken Ude, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Marcella Marlowe, Ph.D., City Manager  San Marino, CA 91108

  SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, MARCH 18, 2022 AT 8:30 A.M.
  SAN MARINO CENTER
  1800 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CALIFORNIA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council with
valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular Meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically, Adjourned
Meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
City Clerk via email at cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300-0705 prior to the
meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each
teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, it is recommended that members of
the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s current Health
Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID-19, you are encouraged to provide input
electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.
 SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA – MARCH 18, 2022  PAGE 2 OF 4

How to participate in the meeting from home:
  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83578890282
  Meeting ID: 835 7889 0282
  2) Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 835 7889 0282
  3) Submit Public Comments via email:
  Email: cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org

How to offer public comment from home:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org until 3:00 p.m.
  the day before the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment. Lengthy
  public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments received after
  3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the meeting.
  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL:  Council Member Huang, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Council Member
  Ude, Vice Mayor Talt, and Mayor Jakubowski

POSTING OF AGENDA

The special meeting agenda is posted 24 hours prior to each special meeting at the following
locations: City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and
the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The special meeting agenda is also posted on the
City’s website: http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by completing
a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. The Mayor reserves the
right to place limits on duration of comments.

  NEW BUSINESS

1.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-12 AFFIRMING THE CITY OF SAN
  MARINO’S SUPPORT FOR THE PEOPLE OF UKRAINE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-12,
  Affirming the City of San Marino’s Support for the People of Ukraine.
 SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA – MARCH 18, 2022  PAGE 3 OF 4

2.  REVIEW OF DRAFT FY 2022-23 CAPITAL EQUIPMENT PLAN AND 5-YEAR
  FORECAST

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council review the draft FY 2022-23 capital
  equipment budget and 5-year plan and provide direction and guidance on two matters: 1)
  approve or reject the proposed FY 2022-23 expenditures, and 2) offer guidance on any FY 2023-
  24 or beyond projects that should be moved up into FY 2022-23.

3.  PRESENTATION ON CAPITAL CONSTRUCTION LIFECYCLE ACTIVITIES
  AND CHALLENGES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the presentation on
  capital construction lifecycle activities and challenges.

4.  RECOMMENDATION FOR THE CITY COUNCIL TO CONCUR ON THE CITY
  MANAGER’S HIRING OF MR. WILLIAM COY AS SAN MARINO HUMAN
  RESOURCES DIRECTOR

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council concur with the City Manager on the
  hiring of Mr. William Coy as Human Resources Director for the City of San Marino.

5.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-13 TO CONTINUE HYBRID PUBLIC
  MEETINGS PURSUANT TO AB 361

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-13 re-
  authorizing the City Council and the City’s Boards and Commissions to continue teleconference
  accessibility for conducting public meetings pursuant to AB 361.

  CLOSED SESSION

1. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(2)

  The City Council is meeting with respect to one (1) matter of significant exposure to litigation
  against the City.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received by
members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at least a
majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at the Public
Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108, and will also
be included in the public agenda packet that will available for review at the City Council meeting.
 SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA – MARCH 18, 2022  PAGE 4 OF 4

PUBLIC COMMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

Dated: March 15, 2022  CHRISTINA BAKER
Posted: March 15, 2022  CITY CLERK
